alerting.title: Alerting & Noise Control
alerting.description: Decouple records from notifications: broad intel sources roll up into the archive while real threats and system failures still notify.

overview.trendHint: The gap is noise absorbed by policy
overview.sourcesHint: Broad sources should show high records and low notifications
overview.criticalWarn: Critical alerts were suppressed. Review policies and silences.

policies.title: Alert policies
policies.subtitle: Resolved by intel_source > blocklist > kind > component > source > global; multiple sources take the highest severity and any notify wins.
policies.name: Name
policies.globalCannotDelete: The global fallback policy cannot be deleted
policies.deleteConfirm: Delete policy "{name}"? Lower-priority scopes will apply.

modeHint.silent: Stored, never enters the notify layer
modeHint.off: Do not create an alert record

policyForm.scopeKeyPlaceholder: Source key / kind / component; empty for global
policyForm.simulateHint: Simulation replays the last 7 days read-only without changing runtime state.

aggregation.title: Aggregation & inhibition
aggregation.desc: A stable fingerprint keeps one alert per window. After acknowledgement, repeat notifications wait for the cooldown or a significant spike.
aggregation.groupingHint: Broad sources should group by source/client; hot sources can keep per-domain detail.
aggregation.inhibitionHint: Suppressed alerts are still stored and visible under "All".
aggregation.rule1: When DNS is down, upstream probe failures are demoted to archive.
aggregation.rule2: System-health critical alerts notify even if configured as off.
aggregation.rule3: A silence suppresses bell and external notifications but keeps the record.
aggregation.rule4: After the per-source or global hourly cap, later alerts roll up into digest.

silences.title: Silence windows
silences.desc: Temporarily suppress notifications by source, kind, intel source, client or domain; expires automatically.
silences.invalidWindow: End time must be after start time
silences.atLeastOne: At least one matcher is required

channels.title: Notification channels
channels.desc: Webhook, email, Feishu, DingTalk, WeCom, Slack and Teams. Secrets are written to 0600 files and never returned.
channels.secretHint: Leave empty to keep the existing secret; check clear to remove it.

deliveries.title: Recent deliveries
deliveries.desc: Actual external delivery results; failures can be diagnosed with channel status.

audit.title: Change audit
audit.desc: Policy, silence and channel changes are written to the unified audit log (last 7 days).
